every story and docs page renders in a browser, not only builds

the docs page says clearly when the scheme leaves the component out, and why
the story canvas is white in light mode and the scheme's own canvas in dark mode
created projects still carry only the components their scheme carries

items.title: Docs: component pages from the component reference, with the Storybook embed, and a Primitives page in the docs and Storybook

each component page embeds its Storybook examples and links to Storybook

a Primitives section of its own, next to Foundations, in the docs and in Storybook: every primitive by kind, with a sample of its value and what points to it (OD-195)

items.title: Docs: branded and visual, wearing the design system
in: the top bar carries the design system's name, version and sections, with Built with Open DS on the right
the home shows a product screen from the system's own components and samples, the answers it cites most, and tiles into every section
the color page shows the key colors, the surfaces in light and dark, and each status in use with its contrast
component pages show the live story, each variant live with its decision and answers, the rules as do and don't, and the answers as cards
primitive colors show as ramps; the same visual styles ship in a created project's docs

items.title: Docs component pages: each variant a full-width section, and each answer a contained card in three steps
in: each variant has its own section: a live sample, what it is for (with use when and not when), this scheme's decision, and the answers behind it
each answer is one card: the answer, what it decided for the component and what else it shapes, and what would move if it changed
the steps stack inside the same card on a phone

items.title: Skills use the component reference and follow the Orchestra skill standard
in: front matter: name, a description with what and Use when in at most 25 words, and the tools the skill uses
every skill has Why, When, Input, Run and Done, with short plain sentences
every listed tool exists and a Run step uses it; every tool, command and skill a skill names exists
review checks variants against the scheme's decisions; change lists what an answer would reopen

items.title: Tools for the skills: check_ui, check_copy, plan_change, find_token, fit_scheme
in: each tool is one engine, served as an MCP tool and a CLI command (check, copy, change, token, fit)
check_ui finds raw values, components the scheme does not carry and variants it does not use; a created project comes back clean
plan_change changes nothing: it lists what an answer reopens, or the contrast a new color keeps in every theme
the skills use the tools: review and build run check_ui, write check_copy, change plan_change, build find_token, choose fit_scheme

items.title: MCP server instructions name only real tools and prompts, and every tool reaches agents
in: every tool and prompt the server instructions name exists
every tool is named in the instructions or in a skill's tools list
the local stdio server and the hosted server send the same instructions

items.title: Context booklets and a router in created projects, from the context engine
in: a created project has context/: one Markdown booklet per component, color and task, a router (index.json) and a README

get_context and open-ds context return the short form by default, with named sections, pages for long sections, and the full answer on request
get_context file=<path> and open-ds context --file return the booklets the router lists
open-ds check reports a context/ that no longer matches the scheme; open-ds context --write regenerates it
every check_ui finding names the booklet section that answers it
the read-once text is in the MCP instructions, AGENTS.md and context/README.md
budgets, routes, fixtures and the before and after benchmark are checked with no model

a created project's docs stay one scheme

a Primitives index in the Foundations style
a Theming page with a preview per mode, one table of what a mode changes, and what stays the same

items.title: Every catalogue component is built: In or Left out, nothing else
in: attachment, bubble, button-group, hover-card, item, marker, menubar, message and message-scroller are built, with stories, docs pages and agent context
each scheme's samples hold a short conversation for the conversation components
the roles answer names the families an inventory draws from first; a component from another family can be in when its entry says where it fits

items.title: Whole color scales in OKLCH, roles on fixed steps, and the status text pair
in: every colored hue has light and dark scales, 50 to 950, generated from a key color exact at 600; the dark scale has its own curve
roles sit on the same step in every color: tints 100, bases 600, hover and links 700
each status has text.<status>-on-light (800) and -on-dark (50), fixed colors; the badge label names its tint and the build picks by tone
steps that carry text are nudged, and the move is recorded on the hue

items.title: Neutral as a semantic scale: roles read neutral, neutral points at a gray
in: primitives hold the grays, each a whole ramp; the grammar keeps the menu with each gray's temperature
color.neutral.0 to 950 is a semantic scale each scheme or brand points at one gray, with why and because
surfaces, borders, text, secondary and disabled read only color.neutral, never a gray directly

items.title: Two neutral text tokens: text on a light fill and text on a dark fill
in: color.text.on-light (the light mode's body text) and color.text.on-dark (white) are the same in both modes
the text on every fill is the one its tone picks; the 14 tone-set tokens are gone
color.text.inverse, color.text.on-action and color.text.on-danger point at the pair by their fill's tone

items.title: Options match the decisions: only what is read, motion as answered, text paired by tone, focus, selected and danger
in: outside color ramps, every primitive is read by a semantic, a theme or a component key
the motion tokens hold as many speeds as each scheme's motion.count answer; panels read their own speed
the agent context carries the rule, generated from the grammar
every fill states its tone, light or dark, in every brand and mode; what sits on it comes from color.on-light or color.on-dark, and keeps its contrast there
a known shortfall waits on its fill with the ticket that fixes it, and the check names it
every focus ring keeps a 2px gap in the canvas color from its control
a selected or current item shows an edge beside its fill, so selection is never color alone
a danger fill, with its own label, for the confirm of a delete; primary and danger stay clearly apart in every brand and mode
our own docs CSS follows the same rule: on a selected row, an action, a status or the inverse surface, text is on-light or on-dark by the fill's tone, never the link color

items.title: Gap ledger: every broken link in the decision trace, counted
in: the ledger is generated from the code and the schemes: each gap has a kind, its component, part, state or semantic, and the ticket that fixes it where one exists

kinds: a key that does not name its part or state, a link to the wrong or a borrowed semantic, one semantic with two jobs, a rule components follow that no semantic states, a component reading another component's key, a component reading the system directly, an option's corner that isn't its container's less the padding, a component drawing what a catalogue component is for, a theme pick with no reason
each kind has a test that pins a known case, so a detector that goes blind fails instead of reporting zero
open-ds gaps, get_gaps and get_component give the gaps to people and agents, so an agent says where the scheme has no answer instead of inventing one
the harness counts gaps per scheme and kind, and each count may only go down

items.title: The typeface is a decision: a question, its considerations, and an answer in every scheme
in: brand.q3 asks which typefaces carry the product and why, and lists what the answer must weigh: readability, legibility, scalability, numerals, scripts, recognition, familiarity, personality, performance, licensing, fallback
every scheme answers it and says how its faces meet each consideration
every font pick quotes the answer, so no font pick is left without a reason

items.title: Line heights: ratios in every scheme, one step per job, steps at least 0.2 apart
in: the grammar's options rules say each option looks clearly different; line heights are ratios at least 0.2 apart
every scheme's line heights follow them, with one step per job
the agent context carries the rule, generated from the grammar
the line-height sample is one line on a band exactly one line height tall, in the docs and Storybook

items.title: Docs: every component shows the tokens it reads, from its classes to the scheme's values
in: the shadcn mapping lives in cli/src/shadcn.mjs; the token build and the docs read the same table
each component built on shadcn lists every part it styles: class, shadcn variable, the scheme's token, and the primitive and value in every theme, with states
the harness fails when a component reads a shadcn variable no scheme token maps

items.title: Decision hints: rules of thumb in the grammar, for agents and the harness
in: each scope can carry hints: when, do, what to measure, why, and the decisions they came from
get_scales and open-ds scales return the color hints, for agents
the harness checks the hints that can be measured
the docs do not show them yet: the human-facing form is refined in OD-232

items.title: Status text on dark shows its hue: on-dark to step 100, adjusted where needed
in: text.<status>-on-dark points at the status hue's light.100 in every scheme
each status hue's light.100 takes just enough chroma (0.04) to show its hue, lightness lowered only where sRGB has no room, recorded with its reason
the light tint shares the step and keeps 7:1 or more with its 800 text

items.title: Pairs and tones as pictures; where scopes land, traced from code
in: Foundations › Color shows each fill in its color with the text that may sit on it, per theme, grouped by tone; then each fill's tone in both modes
each scope's lands_in is traced from the components' code and never hand-written
Foundations pages no longer list where a scope lands or the component keys

items.title: Every component has its own token API
in: every component reads its own tokens (component.<id>.<part>.<name>), each aliasing a semantic; no class reads a system token or a fixed spacing or size directly
a fixed value with no semantic of the same value stays fixed and is listed for a new semantic, never moved to the nearest one
get_component, get_context and open-ds component give agents the whole API: each token, its semantic, its primitive and value per theme, and whether a theme changes it
the component docs page lists the tokens by part, as a tree from its token to the semantic and the CSS variable, with the primitive and value in light and dark

items.title: The component spacing map: the spacing components hard-code follows each scheme's rhythm
in: every spacing inside a component reads a token that links to a semantic or a step of the component spacing map; no component uses a raw spacing class
a step is 4px × its multiplier × the scheme's rhythm, a multiple of 4px and at most 64px; the scheme decides its rhythm and which steps hold still; the hairline is a fixed 2px
the values are computed once when the scheme is written and stored as links to space primitives; no CSS calc
every spacing a scheme decides sits on the 4px grid, at most 64px

items.title: Every semantic value rests on a decision
in: a semantic is linked when its theme pick, its own or its group's reason, a usage rule that names it, or a grammar trace rule for its kind cites an answer the grammar asks and the scheme gives
the owning scope's answers do not count as a link
the harness counts the values with no decision per scheme, and each count may only go down

items.title: Trace engine: every value reaches the answers that decide it, from one source
in: one engine (cli/src/trace.mjs) links a value by its theme pick, its own reason, its group's reason, a usage rule or a grammar trace rule
a grammar trace rule names one kind of token and the questions that decide it, never a whole scope
coverage, the Token map and open-ds trace read the engine, so they never disagree
the Token map shows a why only where the scheme records one
every semantic value has a reason of its own: 6 words or more, citing an answer, not another value's sentence

items.title: Scheme quality gate: a scheme change is measured against master before it can merge
in: open-ds compare --base <ref> [--candidate <ref>] checks out each ref in a temporary worktree and loads it with its own code
a snapshot per ref and scheme: decisions, resolved values per brand and mode, traces and reasons, CSS, component reads and literals
criteria computed by code: traceability, derived against literal, invariants, blast radius, accessibility (WCAG and APCA), motion, repetition, size

color criteria (Jira comment 12136): shift per token by OKLab tier with role, hue and key color limits; relations hold (WCAG level and margin, step and ladder order, state deltas, distinct under simulated color vision deficiencies, shared colors); curve checks
simulated component pairs: each foreground-on-background pair a component draws, before and after, with a review sheet of the flagged pairs
scorecard.json and scorecard.md; harness/quality-baseline.json from origin/master, refreshed on purpose with --write-baseline
the harness fails when a gated criterion moves the wrong way against the baseline

items.title: The type scale: sizes from a base and a ratio, line heights by role kind; spacing by use case and the control scale: values from a base, a multiple and a step; shape and elevation as decisions and relations, and reasons that say why
in: each scheme records on its type group the body size, a ratio, each role's step, and a tight and an open line height with the roles that take each
a role's size is base × ratio^step, rounded to whole px, and links to the font.size primitive of that size; the scale owns the size and line height primitives
the loader generates each size and line height from the type scale (cli/src/type-space-generated.mjs, OD-301); the file stores none of them, and the build fails one set by hand
every size and line height keeps a reason that names its value and relates it to its siblings
the grammar's spacing scope names the use-case words (level, relation, reach) and the job of each spacing property
each scheme records on its space group a base and, per space token, a use case and a multiple; the value is base × multiple
each scheme records on its size group the control scale: the default height, the step, the steps of compact and large, and the row
the loader generates each gap, inset, control height and row from the spacing record and the control scale (OD-301); the spacing.definition answer sets the base, and a row is one default control tall
every space, control and row reason names its value, its job and its use case or mechanism
the grammar records each property's jobs and how it does each: corner, line width, focus ring and shadow
control and surface corners are decisions; option, element and badge follow them by a relation that each scheme records and a check verifies
the focus ring is one step heavier than the default line, with a fixed 2px gap; shadows are one scale by layer, and dark keeps the light shape
where today's values break a relation, the check lists a finding and changes no value
every reason states its job, how the property does it, what people get and the decision; the count of reasons out of the form may only go down

items.title: The accepted design decisions: disabled colors, motion families, reduced motion, dark depth, hit areas, the focus ring and uppercase tracking
in: disabled reads color.disabled.*; no component dims a disabled state with opacity, and opacity.disabled is a deprecated alias

motion has a productive and an expressive family, picked by motion.roles; each duration stays within its family's limit, and each move type (enter, exit, exit-offscreen, transition, emphasize) has its own easing of an allowed curve kind; only the expressive emphasize move overshoots
under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves: fades and color changes stay, at the feedback duration
in dark, raised is a step lighter than content with a solid, lighter 1px ring, sunken is darker, and only floating layers cast a shade
size.hit-area is 24px for a pointer and 44px for touch; checkbox, radio, switch and slider thumb grow their hit area past the drawn box, and groups keep rows apart
the focus ring is its own token, focus.ring.width, one step heavier than the default line
uppercase labels use 0.05 to 0.12em of letter spacing
dense data keeps 12px label and caption text, and its reasons say why

items.title: Icons follow each scheme: one Lucide set, the scheme's size and stroke, and an Icon component for content
in: every scheme answers its icon style and stroke; icon.stroke-width holds the stroke the answer names, and every Lucide icon reads it
the large icon size differs from the default only where the scheme answers two icon sizes
the docs' own visuals draw their icons through Icon, and an icon-only button anywhere has an accessible name

items.title: Every semantic token traces from the scheme answers, through the grammar rules, to its value, and every part of its name means something
in: the decision mapping and the trace rules are one rule set: every semantic token in every scheme has the answers that decide it
the grammar dictionary (semantics.groups, variants, keys) gives every part of a token name a meaning
every reason cites a question that decides its token, cites every answer its text names, and cites another scope only when its text says why
the token map card shows the engine output: the deciding answers, the name meanings and the whole reason

items.title: Color is a decision graph: every color token inherits its reason from role, job, property, answers, rule and connections
in: each color role in the grammar records its role, its jobs, what people get and the tokens that play it; the how comes from the job, so nothing is stored twice
the variants record the step each slot sits at: @ at 600, subtle at 100, hover one step from its fill
semantics.connections lists comes-from, pairs-with (with the step promise) and stays-apart; the gate and the danger check read the surface ladder and the danger rule from it
the decision tree and the token map card show role, jobs, property, answers, rule, connections and value, and the reason sentence written from those fields
category hues stay apart from status hues; today they do not, so the check lists the clashes and keeps a baseline that may only go down
every color token has every link in every brand and mode, and every connection holds, waits for a fix, or is in the baseline

each option of a question a color role depends on lists the roles it creates; each shipped color role is created by a chosen option, or the grammar marks it always-on with a reason and the answers that shape it; the reason cites only answers that create or shape the role
the token map card shows every connection of a color token: comes-from, pairs-with with each measured pair and its step promise, and stays-apart, with a baseline gap shown as waits
